cancellation_summary: 48 hours notice required for up to 5 people; 72 hours for 6 or more people. Same-day cancellations are charged in full.
description: Soar up to 1,000 feet above Oahu’s south shore and enjoy incredible views of Diamond Head and the Pacific Ocean. Choose between 700, 850, 900, or 1,000 feet for your parasailing adventure. Fly tandem or triple, as we do not offer single rides for safety reasons. Enjoy a shared boat experience with up to 15 passengers. Observers are welcome to join the ride without parasailing.

what_is_included_items.value: Parasail ride with the chosen tow line length

what_is_not_included_items.value: An extra $2 cash Fuel Surcharge fee

itinerary:
- **Check-in:** Arrive 30 minutes prior to your tour at Slip F-1 in Kewalo Basin Harbor.
- **Boat Ride:** Enjoy a scenic boat ride before it’s your turn to parasail.
- **Parasail:** Fly up to 1,000 feet in the air, enjoying stunning views.
- **Post-Tour:** Return to the harbor after all guests have had their parasailing experience.
highlights:
- Parasail up to 1,000 feet above Oahu’s south shore
- Enjoy incredible views of Diamond Head and the coastline
- Shared boat experience with up to 15 passengers
- Perfect for friends, families, and adventure seekers
check_in_details: Arrive at least 30 minutes before your scheduled departure time for check-in. Late arrivals will not be accommodated, and no refunds will be given.

what_to_bring_items.value: Swimsuit, board shorts, or rash guard
Cash for the $1 Marine Stewardship fee
Credit card for payment (no cash payments)

special_requirements: - All passengers weighing over 275 lbs must purchase an additional seat.
restrictions:
Pregnant women cannot parasail or ride the boat.
- No single parasailing rides are offered for safety reasons.
- Weather conditions may impact the ability to fly triple or exceed 450 lbs for tandem rides.
faqs:
- **What should I wear?**
  - Wear a swimsuit, board shorts, or rash guard, and be prepared to get wet.

- **Can I bring my child under 5?**
  - No, children under 5 years old are not permitted on the parasail or the boat.

- **What if the weather is bad?**
  - If weather conditions are unsafe, we will contact you to reschedule or provide a refund.
